title: Eamonn Deacy Park
extract: Eamonn Deacy Park, formerly known as Terryland Park, is an association football stadium in the Republic of Ireland based in the Terryland district of Galway. It is owned by the Galway Football Association and is the home ground of both Galway United men's and women's teams. It was the home of Galway W.F.C. before they dissolved in 2022 and were replaced by Galway United WFC. It is named after Eamonn Deacy, a former Galway United and Aston Villa player and Republic of Ireland international. In both 2007 and 2008, the ground was voted the best surface by the FAI. It won the same award again in 2015. In 1950 the Galway Football Association purchased the grounds for £250 from Eamonn Deacy's grandfather.
